As your trusted dentist in Wilmington-Downtown, NC, our experienced team of dental professionals is dedicated to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Welcome to our Wilmington - Downtown office! Our office stands out with its modern atmosphere and advanced technology, making your dental experience stress-free. Our skillful and attentive team strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we designed our office and amenities with your health and well-being in mind. Our patients feel supported and at ease, leaving motivated and confident to care for their oral health.

Our Wilmington - Downtown location is conveniently situated in a suburban community, just off US-74 / US-76. It offers small-town charm with easy access to Airlie Gardens and Independence Mall. We provide care for the Wilmington - Downtown community and patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as Navassa, Leland, Northwest, and more. Our connection with clients goes beyond the dental chair. You are now part of the Riccobene family, where we are committed to providing the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, painless smile!
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Wilmington office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!
We understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!
Yes! We have an amazing team of professionals ready to help you with your Invisalign® needs to discreetly straighten your teeth for a brighter, natural smile.
Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants.
We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.
At Wilmington – Downtown, we offer a variety of sedation dentistry options. You can choose from Nitrous Oxide, IV Sedation, and Local Anesthesia.

We use digital X-rays, which have a small sensor and X-ray film tabs, as well as panoramic X-rays, where you stand still while a machine rotates around your head and takes a single image of your entire mouth.
Yes, we offer oral cancer screenings. Early cancer detection is critical for proper treatment and recovery. Your health is our priority.
Yes. Our expert team can remove your wisdom teeth before or after they come in. We prioritize your comfort throughout the process and make sure the removal process is painless and relaxing.
Yes, we offer both dentures and dental bridges as options for replacing missing teeth.

schemaMarkup.reviewBody: I've had a wisdom tooth extraction and a root canal done here, and they were both as painless as possible. I've got more procedures coming up and I am significantly less anxious than I was before.

I was met by friendly staff who explained every treatment recommended, ran my insurance for them, and set appointment dates. The dentist was professional and thorough. AND I appreciated the parking pass in the adjacent lot.

Having recently relocated from Nashville, I needed to find a new dentist and was recommended to Riccobene Associates by a colleague. I am certainly glad that I took them up on the suggestion. Highly recommended!!!

I have always been a regular at the dentist, but this is by far the best dentist I have ever been to! They are SO caring and helpful, talk you through everything, and actually care about you as a patient. I recommend them to everyone!

I was referred to Riccobene Denistry by a friend, and they were Awesome. I was going on vacation soon and needed to get in quickly ( I had just moved here and didn’t have a dentist yet). I called and got an appointment in a day. Everyone was extremely professional and friendly. They were very knowledgeable and provided several recommendations for my care. I will be going back for treatment, and I highly recommend them.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services are offered at the Wilmington – Downtown office?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

What cosmetic dentistry options are available in Wilmington – Downtown?

We understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Is emergency same-day dental care available in Wilmington – Downtown?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Do you offer Invisalign® in Wilmington – Downtown NC?

Yes! We have an amazing team of professionals ready to help you with your Invisalign® needs to discreetly straighten your teeth for a brighter, natural smile.

Can I get dental implants at the Wilmington – Downtown office?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants.

How often should I schedule cleanings and exams in Wilmington – Downtown?

We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.

What sedation options are available at Wilmington – Downtown?

At Wilmington – Downtown, we offer a variety of sedation dentistry options. You can choose from Nitrous Oxide, IV Sedation, and Local Anesthesia.

What x-ray technology is used to ensure modern, precise dental care in Wilmington – Downtown?

We use digital X-rays, which have a small sensor and X-ray film tabs, as well as panoramic X-rays, where you stand still while a machine rotates around your head and takes a single image of your entire mouth.

Do you perform oral cancer screenings in Wilmington – Downtown?

Yes, we offer oral cancer screenings. Early cancer detection is critical for proper treatment and recovery. Your health is our priority.

Do you offer wisdom teeth removal at the Wilmington – Downtown location?

Yes. Our expert team can remove your wisdom teeth before or after they come in. We prioritize your comfort throughout the process and make sure the removal process is painless and relaxing.

Are dentures and dental bridges available in Wilmington – Downtown?

Yes, we offer both dentures and dental bridges as options for replacing missing teeth.
